hint.notification_initialize: When initialized, BOLT12 Pay validates and encrypts your notification nsec. If no internal app signer exists yet, the required key pair is created automatically in the background. LND automatically unlocks both keys after every app or node restart; private keys are never displayed.
hint.app_signer_keypair: BOLT12 Pay creates a key pair for this. Only the public npub is shown here; the private nsec remains hidden.
hint.regenerate_app_signer: Use this only if the app signer is faulty or compromised. The notification nsec is not changed.
hint.notification_profile_match: Use the nsec of the same Nostr profile in which you entered your Zap-enabled Lightning Address. The npub shown after initialization must match the saved Identity.
hint.notification_nsec_security: Your nsec grants full control of your Nostr identity. Store it only on a node you trust and never share it with third parties.
hint.notification_nsec_change: For security, the saved nsec is never loaded back into this field. To replace it, enter the new nsec above and select Save new notification nsec.
confirm.regenerate_app_signer: Generate a new app signer? The current signer will no longer be used for future Zap receipts. The notification nsec will not be changed.
confirm.reset_nostr_keys: Reset the encrypted Nostr keys for this LND node? The saved notification nsec and app signer will be deleted and must be entered or created again.
